description: This file contains shell script functions for configuring GRE (Generic Routing Encapsulation) tunnels, including setup, teardown, and initialization for IPv4 and IPv6 variants, as well as related network interface management.

methods.name: gre_generic_setup
methods.description: Configures a GRE tunnel with specified parameters, including JSON data preparation and tunnel initialization.

methods.name: gre_setup
methods.description: Sets up IPv4 GRE tunnel based on mode and peer address, resolving IP and handling routing dependencies.

methods.name: proto_gre_setup
methods.description: Wrapper to call gre_setup with 'greip' mode.

methods.name: proto_gretap_setup
methods.description: Sets up a GRETAP tunnel with network interface configuration.

methods.name: grev6_setup
methods.description: Configures an IPv6 GRE tunnel, resolving IPv6 peer address and handling routing.

methods.name: proto_grev6_setup
methods.description: Wrapper to call grev6_setup with 'greip6' mode.

methods.name: proto_grev6tap_setup
methods.description: Sets up an IPv6 GRETAP tunnel with network interface configuration.

methods.name: gretap_generic_teardown
methods.description: Removes devices associated with a GRETAP tunnel from network interfaces.

methods.name: gre_generic_init_config
methods.description: Initializes common configuration options for GRE tunnels.

methods.name: proto_gre_init_config
methods.description: Initializes configuration options specific to IPv4 GRE.

methods.name: proto_grev6_init_config
methods.description: Initializes configuration options for IPv6 GRE.

methods.name: proto_grev6tap_init_config
methods.description: Initializes configuration options for IPv6 GRETAP.
